headline: Transfer rumors, news: Real Madrid, Barcelona chase Spurs defender Porro
description: Tottenham defender Pedro Porro is being tracked by Real Madrid and Barcelona. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Chelsea confident in January move for Scott
description: Chelsea are growing confident of signing Bournemouth's Alex Scott. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Lisandro Martínez slams Man United hierarchy: Squad not Champions League quality
description: Lisandro Martínez launched a stinging verbal attack on Manchester United's hierarchy, after a 2-0 Champions League defeat against Atlético Madrid.

headline: Arsenal showed strength in depth in Lille win, but Gyökeres is a concern
description: Arsenal's substitutes made the difference once again, but Mikel Arteta's side still have questions as tougher tests await.

headline: Man City 'deserved' trophies - PSG boss Luis Enrique on charges
description: Paris Saint-Germain boss Luis Enrique has said Manchester City deserve to keep the trophies won during the period in which they have been found guilty of breaching Premier League rules.

headline: Football Regulator chair will quit if politics interferes with any Man City investigation
description: The chair of the Independent Football Regulator (IFR) has said he will quit if there is political interference in any future investigation launched into Manchester City.
